title: Bringing ChatGPT for Teachers to more U.S. school districts
summary: ChatGPT for Teachers is expanding to 55 U.S. school systems, bringing secure AI tools, training, and support to over 100,000 more educators and staff.
body: ChatGPT for Teachers is expanding to 55 U.S. school systems, bringing secure AI tools, training, and support to over 100,000 more educators and staff.
summaryZh: OpenAI 宣布其“ChatGPT for Teachers”工具正扩展至美国 55 个学区，为超过 10 万名教育工作者提供安全的人工智能工具和培训支持。
